text:
Milan will have to do without defender Fikayo Tomori until after the November international break, as the Englishman is expected to miss a month’s worth of action after picking up an injury during Wednesday night’s 4-2 defeat against Bologna.
According to the latest updates from Sky Sport Italia, Tomori has suffered an injury to the medial flexor muscle in his right thigh, which is expected to keep him out of action for one month.
This rules him out of the upcoming Derby della Madonnina between Milan and Inter on Saturday evening, as well as his side’s next two matches against Ferencvaros and Genoa heading into the international break.
Tomori is also unlikely to feature for the next few games after the break as well, with matches against Frosinone on November 22, Olympiacos on November 26 and Cagliari on November 30 on the calendar.
In more encouraging news, Milan are hoping to count on the returns of Mario Gila, Diego Moreira and Adrien Rabiot for their test against Inter on Sunday.
digest_he: קבוצת מילאן תיאלץ להסתדר בלעדיו של שחקן ההגנה פיקאיו טומורי למשך חודש שלם, לאחר שהאנגלי ספג פציעה בשריר הירך במהלך ההפסד 4-2 לבולוניה. פציעה זו פוסלת אותו מלהשתתף בדרבי הקרוב מול אינטר וכן במשחקים מול פרנצווארוש וגנואה. במקביל, בקבוצה מקווים לקבל בחזרה שחקנים אחרים לקראת ההתמודדויות הבאות.
